hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$(basename "$f")" in go.sum|go.work.sum) echo 'go.sum/go.work.sum are managed by the Go toolchain: run go mod tidy / go work sync instead of editing them.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac; exit 0
